hook: Inail recorded 325,525 workplace injury claims across 9 months of 2026.

sections.voiceover: Inail recorded 325,525 workplace injury claims across 9 months of 2026.

In November 2026, Inail released workplace data excluding students. Commuting accidents accounted for another 75,966 recorded claims. Didn't November 2026 Inail data show where total fatal injury claims reached across categories?
Worse, Inail recorded 810 total fatal injury claims across workplace and commuting categories.
Inail registered a 16.3% increase in professional disease claims during those nine months. Inail also documented 75,966 commuting accidents excluding students during that same period.
Inail confirmed total fatal injury claims reached 810 cases.
